## Overview

Standalone notebook/report in the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-)—Time-series forecasting of gold prices using historical market data.

## Problem & Data

Investors and analysts track gold as a macro indicator; short-horizon forecasts aid planning.

## Approach

Historical price series EDA, stationarity checks, ARIMA/prophet-style modeling, forecast visualization.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · statsmodels · Matplotlib · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Forecast plots with confidence intervals and model diagnostics.
